reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

title.narrative: FBIH Roads - Flood Repair and Upgrade

description.narrative: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development is providing a sovereign loan to BiH in the amount of up to EUR 65 million for on-lending to the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina (FBH) and further to the Public Company Roads of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina (the 'FBIH Roads') to finance the repair and modernisation of selected road sections and structures in the FBH. The proceeds of the loan will be used to repair and upgrade the primary road network in the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina ('FBIH') following the damage caused by the severe floods during the Spring of 2014, In addition, the financing is aiming to improve the level of service and traffic safety on the FBIH primary road network.
